title: FanBasis (now Commas) alternatives: 10 best options for 2026
snippet:
FanBasis works by giving sellers one place to host, create, and sell products, all built on one [API](https://whop.com/blog/best-payment-processor-apis/).

Subscription billing, event ticketing, and free trial features are available, as well as ways to recruit, track, and pay affiliates.

It's free to start selling, as FanBasis operates on a revenue-share model, meaning they make money when you do.
However, exact fees and rates for payments products (including financing, affiliate splits, and each local payment method) aren't public. After digging through the documentation and website, we couldn't find any pricing figures.

FanBasis is free to start and operates on a revenue-share model, taking a cut when you make sales. The exact rates (including payment processing, BNPL, and affiliate splits) aren't published, so sellers need to confirm their specific pricing with the Commas team directly.
